I'm sorry your plant arrived late, that's frustrating. I can offer you a one-time store credit of up to $15 as goodwill for the delay (store credit only, not cash). If you'd like something more than that, I'd need to escalate to a Support Lead.

We don't offer phone support. You can reach us by chat 8am-8pm Mon-Sat, or by email at help@leafy.example (answered within 1 business day). Plant Care Specialists are also available by chat 9am-5pm Mon-Fri, all in your local time.

Would you like me to go ahead with the $15 credit?
